answer: Require every identity to post a bond that stays locked for a full epoch before it can earn or vote. One honest agent pays that cost once and climbs toward the zenith of its standing; a sybil swarm must pay it per fake, crossing a tundra of locked capital with no shortcut. Build each terrace of reputation on settled, bonded history, and when linked fakes are exposed their bonds burn together — so the attacker's bill grows with every identity they invent, while a real participant's cost stays flat.
